notes: Manifest for the Priority 3 router proof run, Nov 19, 2026. Scope: sealed wiring proofs in the clone only, reads and counts only, no spend. No subagents were spawned; the generator ran directly, so spawnMax is 1. Passes starts false for every unit; the verification file carries the pass verdicts. The router call log holds the four called skills only; the negative routing test has no call by design and is not logged here. Fix cycle Nov 19, 2026: the P3-U3 output path now names constraint-based-discovery-handoff.md, and prohibitedActions no longer lists bare git. Read-only git (log, status, rev-parse) is allowed and covers the status check that opened the run; commit and push stay prohibited.
prohibitedActions: edit any file outside the clone

routerCallLog.saw: the Nov 15 Abduction handoff files 3 ranked explanations for the 39-case yield gap, each with a prediction and a killer test named before any result was known
routerCallLog.trigger: You need a check that can prove a claim wrong
routerCallLog.why: the next step needs a verdict on the ranked explanations, not another explanation, and Falsification runs the killer tests and keeps only survivors

routerCallLog.saw: forward curation work failed, Nov 15 built 1 usable case against a bar of 40, after Nov 9 built 20 and Nov 11 built 13, so the forward route is stuck
routerCallLog.trigger: Forward work has failed, so work back from failure
routerCallLog.why: the goal has a clear result and number (40 usable cases in one run), and the next step needs workable steps derived from what would guarantee failure, not another forward plan

routerCallLog.saw: three killer tests from the Abduction handoff compete for the next unit, and hard limits decide between them: only read-only tests can run in this proof run, and the kill condition must already be filed
routerCallLog.trigger: A hard limit shapes what can work
routerCallLog.why: the choice is a pick under stated constraints, and the skill checks each candidate against each constraint, rejects violators by name, and tests the pick on a new case

routerCallLog.saw: while reading the Nov 15 Anomaly handoff, the listed held reasons sum to 208, not the 213 total the handoff states, a surprise with a number and a source
routerCallLog.trigger: A chance find meets a mind ready to see its use
routerCallLog.why: the observation is unexpected, and the next step needs a judgement on whether to follow it or park it, not a verdict on the curation gap itself
